title: Freizeitpark Salvenaland Hopfgarten
highlights: Versatile family leisure park with a natural bathing lake and heated swimming pool
Summer toboggan run, minigolf course, and mini-car track for kids
Sprawling adventure playground with climbing castle, zipline, and giant jumping cushion
Restaurant featuring a large sun terrace situated directly by the bathing lake
kurzbeschreibung: Salvenaland in Hopfgarten im Brixental combines a swimming lake, heated outdoor pool, summer toboggan run, and adventure playground.
beschreibung:
Family Paradise in the Brixental

The Freizeitpark Salvenaland in Hopfgarten im Brixental is an ideal destination for families with children. The heart of the park is the idyllic natural bathing lake fed with pure spring water, complemented by a heated 25-metre sports pool and a paddling pool for toddlers.

Games, Sports, and Summer Toboggan Run

On land, a fast-paced summer toboggan run, a modern 18-hole minigolf course, trampolines, and tennis courts ensure top-tier entertainment. Youngest visitors can romp around on the spacious playground with water features, while parents relax on the lakeside terrace.
